_meta: Committed source of truth for the Athena Inbox tenancy registry — which projects this machine expects to have a registry entry for, and what each entry says. The live entries are untracked machine-local files at $ATHENA_INBOX_ROOT/projects/<file> (0600, in a 0700 directory); `scripts/setup-inbox-registry --install` materialises them from here by MERGING (it touches only the files declared here and never the rest of the directory), and `ai/bin/check-inbox-registry` fails naming each entry that is missing or drifted. Without these three artifacts a clobbered entry is silent by contract — zero channels, exit 0 — and unrecoverable from git, the 2026-09-17 hook-clobber class. See ai/contracts/athena-inbox.md -> Provisioning, Tenancy: the registry. NO SECRET EVER GOES IN THIS FILE: the machine token lives at ~/.config/athena-inbox-client/config.json and nowhere else. `repo` is the realpath of the project's git common dir and MAY be written with a leading ~/ , which is expanded (and realpath'd, when the path exists) at install and check time.
